The exact owner-local initial edge for PumpControl (source_inventory tr_0002 / FCSTM transition:line:26, scope=PumpControl) targets InitialState, a leaf state with zero outgoing transitions, not PumpState. PumpState itself is a separate composite (source line 7) never targeted by any PumpControl-scoped initial edge.

Consequences observed in the same closed model (folded sub-claims, each an obligation settled by this root cause): (1) InitialState is a reachable leaf without outgoing transition: Exact reachable leaf state:InitialState:line:25 has no outgoing transition refs. (2) PumpControl's default entry reaches only a dead-end placeholder, never the three required operating regions: PumpControl's only default-entry edge (transition:line:26 / tr_0002) targets InitialState, a synthetic leaf with zero outgoing transitions (LEAF_WITHOUT_OUTGOING at line 25). None of PumpState, WaterState, or MethaneState (nor their descendants) is reachable_from_initial=true in inspection_equivalent_facts.states; verify_facts.non_proved lists reachability refuted for PumpState, WaterState, MethaneState and all their children. The three regions' own internal entry edges (transition:line:10,16,22) are marked INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL because they carry triggers, so they cannot substitute for a default owner-level path into these regions from PumpControl. (3) PumpState and its subtree are unreachable from the model root: inspection_equivalent_facts marks PumpState, RunningState, and FinalWaittr_0004 as reachable_from_initial=false; the only reachable states are the root wrapper, PumpControl, and InitialState (a dead-end leaf). verify_facts explicitly refutes reachability:state:PumpState:line:7 and reachability:state:RunningState:line:8 under the closed_fcstm_hierarchy finite scope. (4) Required operating scope PumpState is unreachable from root: The exact inspection-equivalent facts mark state:PumpState:line:7 and its bound required behavior as unreachable from the top-level initial entry. (5) Required operating scope WaterState is unreachable from root: The exact inspection-equivalent facts mark state:WaterState:line:13 and its bound required behavior as unreachable from the top-level initial entry. (6) Required operating scope MethaneState is unreachable from root: The exact inspection-equivalent facts mark state:MethaneState:line:19 and its bound required behavior as unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
